basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 27-year-old tech enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a junior software developer and by night, I dive into my passions of cryptocurrency and online gaming. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore new hobbies, like home defense systems and learning about blockchain technology. I'm usually online in the evenings, especially around 8 PM to midnight CST, after winding down from work. I dislike overly aggressive arguments and try to keep things light-hearted.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which fueled my interest in technology and blockchain. I started learning about cryptocurrencies through online courses and forums. I'm also self-taught in home security systems, sparked by a desire to protect my own home.
